```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {reactivity, KEV, E_FUS, E_ALPHA} from "./fusion.js"
import {INK, MUTED, GREY, BLUE, ORANGE} from "./plotting.js"
rx = FileAttachment("data/reactivity.json").json()
font = ({fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "16px", color: INK, background: "transparent"})
sub = (svg) => {
  for (const t of svg.querySelectorAll("text")) {
    if (!/[_^]/.test(t.textContent)) continue;
    t.innerHTML = t.textContent
      .replace(/_(\w+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>')
      .replace(/\^(\S+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>');
  }
  return svg;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Uniform 50:50 D-T, n = n_e, T_e = T_i: tau_E needed for gain Q, 3 n T / tau_E = n^2/4 <sigma v> (E_alpha + E_fus/Q).
heat = Q === Infinity ? E_ALPHA : E_ALPHA + E_FUS / Q
tauReq = (T, n20) => 12 * T / (n20 * 1e20 * reactivity(rx, "DT", T) * heat)
pmax = beta / 100 * B * B / (2 * 4e-7 * Math.PI)          // Pa
nCap = (T) => Math.min(stellarator ? Infinity : nmax, pmax / (2 * T * KEV) / 1e20)
Tdom = [3, 40]
ndom = [0.02, 3]
best = {
  let b = null;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 600; i++) {
    const T = Tdom[0] * (Tdom[1] / Tdom[0]) ** (i / 600), n20 = nCap(T);
    if (n20 > ndom[1] * 4) continue;
    const t = tauReq(T, n20);
    if (!b || t < b.tau) b = {T, n20, tau: t};
  }
  return b;
}
Tx = pmax / (2 * nmax * 1e20) / KEV
extent = ({x1: Tdom[0], x2: Tdom[1], y1: ndom[0], y2: ndom[1], width: 160, height: 110})
```

```{ojs}
html`<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start">${sub(Plot.plot({
  width: 640, height: 330, marginLeft: 60, marginRight: 70, marginTop: 26, marginBottom: 50, style: font,
  x: {type: "log", domain: Tdom, ticks: [3, 5, 10, 13.5, 20, 25.7, 40], tickFormat: (d) => String(d), label: "k_B T [keV]", labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: "none", labelOffset: 40},
  y: {domain: ndom, label: "n [10^20 m^−3]", labelArrow: "none"},
  color: {type: "log", domain: [0.3, 30], range: ["#0072B2", "#FFFFFF"], clamp: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.raster({...extent, fill: (T, n) => tauReq(T, n), imageRendering: "auto"}),
    Plot.contour({...extent, fill: null, value: (T, n) => Math.log10(tauReq(T, n)), thresholds: [-0.301, 0, 0.301, 0.699, 1], stroke: BLUE, strokeWidth: 1.2}),
    Plot.contour({...extent, value: (T, n) => n / nCap(T), thresholds: [1], fill: "#9AA5B1", fillOpacity: 0.75, stroke: null}),
    Plot.line(d3.range(0, 301).map((i) => Tdom[0] * (Tdom[1] / Tdom[0]) ** (i / 300)), {x: (T) => T, y: (T) => nCap(T), stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.4, clip: true}),
    Plot.ruleX([13.54, 25.67], {stroke: GREY, strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
    Plot.dot([best], {x: "T", y: "n20", r: 7, fill: "white", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.frame({stroke: GREY}),
  ],
}))}
<div style="font-size:0.8rem;line-height:1.45;width:300px;color:${INK}">
  ${Plot.legend({color: {type: "log", domain: [0.3, 30], range: ["#0072B2", "#FFFFFF"]}, width: 280, label: "τ_E needed [s]", ticks: [0.3, 1, 3, 10], tickFormat: (d) => String(d), style: {fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "13px"}})}
  <div style="color:${MUTED}">blue lines: τ<sub>E</sub> = 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10 s<br>grey: beyond ${stellarator ? "β limit" : "density or β limit"}<br>dashed: 13.5 keV (best at fixed <i>p</i>), 25.7 keV (best at fixed <i>n</i>)</div>
  <div style="margin-top:0.6rem"><b>least τ<sub>E</sub> needed ○</b><br>
  <i>k</i><sub>B</sub><i>T</i> = ${best.T.toFixed(1)} keV, <i>n</i> = ${best.n20.toFixed(2)} × 10<sup>20</sup> m<sup>−3</sup><br>
  τ<sub>E</sub> = ${best.tau.toFixed(2)} s, <i>p</i> = ${(pmax / 1e5).toFixed(1)} bar</div>
  ${stellarator ? html`<div style="color:${MUTED};margin-top:0.4rem">no density limit: best at the β limit at 13.5 keV</div>`
    : html`<div style="color:${MUTED};margin-top:0.4rem">limits cross at <i>T</i><sub>×</sub> = <i>p</i><sub>max</sub>/2<i>n</i><sub>max</sub> = ${Tx.toFixed(1)} keV<br>optimum = <i>T</i><sub>×</sub> clamped to [13.5, 25.7] keV</div>`}
</div></div>`
```

```{ojs}
viewof B = Inputs.range([2, 20], {value: 6, step: 0.1, label: html`<i>B</i> [T]`})
viewof beta = Inputs.range([1, 10], {value: 4.5, step: 0.1, label: html`<i>β</i><sub>max</sub> [%]`})
viewof nmax = Inputs.range([0.3, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.05, label: html`<i>n</i><sub>max</sub> [10<sup>20</sup>]`})
viewof qsel = Inputs.radio(["Q = 1", "Q = 10", "ignition"], {value: "ignition", label: "target"})
viewof stellarator = Inputs.toggle({label: "no density limit (stellarator)", value: false})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
Q = qsel === "Q = 1" ? 1 : qsel === "Q = 10" ? 10 : Infinity
{
  for (const [view, v] of [[viewof B, `${B.toFixed(1)} T`], [viewof beta, `${beta.toFixed(1)} %`], [viewof nmax, `${nmax.toFixed(2)} × 10²⁰ m⁻³`]]) {
    const div = view.querySelector("div");
    const out = div.querySelector("output") ?? div.appendChild(document.createElement("output"));
    out.textContent = v;
  }
}
```
